about: The reference board: the art seen with no match running (the Bevy client's ?pose mode, ci/look.mjs on SwiftShader), beside references and the operator's marks. node tools/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; build first (cargo build --release -p server, ci/client.sh). The fx-* views are the fx stage's strips (tools/fx.sh, the fx skill): one effect over a dark and a light card, every frame of it, measured against the plate and the last run. The hd-* views are Dry Fork from four fixed eyes, shot on this box's GPU at HIGH in seconds (tools/hd.sh; the hd skill is the loop), each beside the moodboard picture it is measured against (private: ELO_REF_DIR=moodboard).

views.name: A fighter, facing you
views.what: a fighter facing the camera with a long gun, in the arena
views.take: a silhouette you read as an enemy at a glance, and where to aim

refs.take: the gun in view: big, lower right, its display readable; the body and weapon read apart
refs.ignore: the landscape, the HUD

views.name: A fighter, side on
views.what: a fighter side on with a long gun
views.take: the body and the gun read apart; the head is the obvious target

views.name: A fighter with a pistol
views.what: a fighter side on with a pistol
views.take: which gun someone holds, from across the room

views.name: A fighter running away
views.what: a fighter running away with a heavy weapon
views.take: motion and the weapon read from behind

views.name: Bulkhead: red's deck
views.what: Bulkhead from red's deck, 3 m up, over the pit to blue's base
views.take: the whole map reads from home: the bridge, the pit, both lanes, which base is whose

views.name: Bulkhead: bottom mid
views.what: the pit under the bridge, from beside red's low wall
views.take: the pit is its own place: cover to fight around, the lifts, the bridge overhead

views.name: Bulkhead: top mid
views.what: on top mid with the sniper, looking down the bridge at blue's deck
views.take: the long sight line and where it's exposed; the far base reads as blue

views.name: Bulkhead: a side lane
views.what: red's end of the north lane, looking along it
views.take: the lane is a route of its own, and the steps down into the pit read

views.name: Chrysalis: red's top
views.what: from red's pod roof, over its rolled parapet, to the ring and the chrysalis
views.take: nothing reads as a box: the pod's roof, the parapet, the ring and the hanging chrysalis are round; the far pod reads as blue

refs.take: a ship's hall: pearl-purple curved hull plates, dark floor grating, round ceiling lamps, light strips along plate edges, gold hex windows overhead
refs.ignore: the vehicle, the logo

views.name: Chrysalis: bottom mid
views.what: in the pit under the ring, the spine and the chrysalis overhead
views.take: an alien interior, not a box: the ring, the spine and the chrysalis hung over it read at a glance

refs.take: a ship interior lit from within: purple walls with magenta slits, blue-white lift beams, a column through the middle; lit enough to read a fighter

views.name: Chrysalis: top mid
views.what: on the ring by the spine, looking at blue's pod
views.take: where the fights are reads; the hull's veins glow without hiding fighters

refs.take: curved ribbed ceiling with lamps, the hall reads long and tall
refs.ignore: the vehicle, the logo

views.name: Chrysalis: the south hall
views.what: the south lane from red's end, the pods and the spiral ramps
views.take: the lane is a route of its own; the spiral ramp and the bulging hull plates read as curves

refs.take: the walls' plates read as sculpted hull, not boxes; cyan and magenta accents, nothing grey

views.name: Effect: a round on metal
views.what: a rifle round on metal on the fx stage: dark card left, light card right
views.take: a white-hot star for a frame, sparks that streak and cool to ember and skitter once, a small grey puff; reads with bloom off (the browser has none)

views.name: Effect: a round on a shield
views.what: a rifle round on a fighter's shield on the fx stage
views.take: a blue-white crack of light, arcs crawling and gold specks thrown off; no dust, no blood: the shield took it

views.name: Effect: a sniper round on concrete
views.what: a sniper round into a wall on the fx stage
views.take: heavier than a rifle's: more grit and a bigger puff, a few sparks; the mark left on the card

views.name: Effect: a rifle's muzzle
views.what: the rifle's muzzle flash on the fx stage
views.take: a star and a tongue of fire for a frame or two, a breath of grey smoke after; nothing hangs

views.name: Effect: a frag going off
views.what: a grenade's blast on the fx stage, framed for 2.2 m
views.take: a flash, an orange fireball that cools to red, sparks thrown wide, then smoke that rises and hangs; the light card shows the smoke's body

views.name: Effect: a rocket going off
views.what: a rocket's blast on the fx stage, framed for 2.4 m
views.take: bigger than the frag: more fire, more smoke, the same order of flash, fire, sparks, smoke

views.name: Effect: a shield breaking
views.what: a fighter's shield breaking on the fx stage
views.take: the shell bursting: a ring of light and shards of it thrown off; quick

views.name: Dry Fork: the beach, out to sea
views.what: the beach at blue's back, looking out over the shallows to the horizon
views.take: a shore you would stop to look at: rock in the water and on the sand, something standing out at sea, the sand's grain underfoot, a horizon under built cloud

refs.take: dark rocks standing in the shallows and lying on the sand; sea stacks with green tops offshore; tufts and scrub on the beach; a hard clear horizon under built-up cumulus; sand with grain and tracks in it
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

views.name: Dry Fork: the canyon wall from the floor
views.what: the south wall from the middle of the floor, across the scree
views.take: a wall that is rock: broken into faces and beds, lit and shaded, with growth on its ledges and at its foot

refs.take: a sunlit cliff broken into faces, trees and grass on its ledges and along its foot, green ground running up to it
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

refs.take: rock crisp close up: fractured planes, strata, moss and grass where a ledge holds soil
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

refs.take: a wall that stands sheer from a short bank to a hard, angular crest, green on its top
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

views.name: Dry Fork: a hill's grass
views.what: across red's north hill toward the wall and the far end
views.take: ground cover that reads as a meadow, not tufts on sand: a carpet with clumps in it, flowers in drifts, bare tracks between

refs.take: grass as a continuous carpet with taller clumps; yellow flowers in drifts; a worn dirt track; stones with moss; trees closing the view; shade dappled over the ground

views.name: Dry Fork: the canyon from red's roof
views.what: from red's bunker roof down the canyon to the sea
views.take: depth: near things crisp and saturated, each further thing a step paler; a sky with clouds that have tops and bases

refs.take: layers of distance, the near rock crisp and the far ridges stepping back into haze; cloud with lit tops and shaded bases, some below the skyline; water far below
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

refs.take: trails worn from base to base through the grass; walls with peaks and notches along their tops
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

views.name: Dry Fork: back up the canyon from the beach
views.what: from blue's side by the beach, looking west up the canyon over blue's bunker
views.take: a canyon cut into higher country: walls with a hard crest, more land standing beyond the far end, trails worn across the floor

refs.take: sheer walls ending in sharp angular crests; higher cliffs beyond the far end, paler with distance; dirt trails winding between patches of grass; a few rounded boulders
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

views.name: Dry Fork: red's base
views.what: red's base from the floor, the wall behind it
views.take: a base that was built of metal: plate with seams that catch the light, buttress pylons, lights in its team's colour, standing on worn ground under a wall with a jagged skyline

refs.take: a base with battered walls, trim bands, posts and lights in its team's colour; a sheer wall behind with an angular crest and green on its top; big natural boulders; conifers
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

refs.take: a round base of grey metal seen from above: radial roof panels, buttresses standing round its rim, a hatch in the middle of its roof
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

refs.take: metal as a material: engraved panel lines, chamfered slabs, a round deck cut with a radial pattern, pale wear on the edges
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures, the ring in the sky

views.name: Cloudbreak: the ring under the struts
views.what: the plaza from the south-west dune, up a little, the struts across it and the spire beyond
views.take: a round stone floor with a strong silhouette over it; warm rounded sandstone against cool hard grey stone; the edge and the cloud beyond in view

refs.take: a round plaza cut with a pattern, two leaning struts that never meet, sand mounded round it with rounded boulders, a grey stone tower to one side, an overcast sky, a flat sea of mist and pale stacks of rock far off
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

views.name: Cloudbreak: the island from off its edge
views.what: from the void south-east of the island, level with its rim and looking down a little, its cliff, the keel it hangs from and the cloud far under it, the ring and the spire beyond
views.take: an island high over nothing: its edge, the rock under it, undercut, and the void a third of the frame

refs.take: sandstone undercut into arches and fingers under the island's edge; rounded boulders along the rim; grey architecture on the cliff; mist below, stacks of rock behind
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

views.name: Cloudbreak: out over the void
views.what: from the south point, out over the sea of cloud
views.take: distance that reads as height: a flat sea of cloud far below, stacks of rock standing out of it each a step paler, an overcast with a break in it

refs.take: the sea of mist, flat to the horizon; stacks of rock standing out of it, paler with distance; the cloud deck grey with a lighter break
refs.ignore: the gun in view, the HUD, the figures

refs.take: rocks far off on the mist, pale; the light coming through the cloud
